Create a square 1:1 Instagram-ready product image using only Image 1.

Use Image 1 as the only content. Preserve the model's face, identity, skin tone, expression, makeup, hair, pose, black dress, jewelry, sandals, and beige draped fabric background exactly.

Do not add any border. Do not add text, logo, watermark, props, archway, plants, room elements, or anything from Image 2.

Output a clean square full-body product image.

nodes.title: Framed
widgets_values:
Create a square 1:1 Instagram-ready product image using Image 1 and Image 2.

Image 1 is the product. Image 2 is the reference layout.

Use Image 2 only for the composition: soft pink fabric background, centered rounded-rectangle frame, frame size, frame position, rounded corners, shadow, lighting, and spacing.

Place Image 1 inside the centered rounded-rectangle frame. Preserve Image 1 exactly: the model’s visible identity, skin tone, expression, makeup, hair, pose, black dress, jewelry, hands, fabric texture, color, neckline, buttons, and all product details.

Do not add any border. Do not add any white margin, white padding, outer frame, text, logo, watermark, props, archway, plants, room elements, extra face, extra eyes, forehead, extra body parts, new jewelry, embroidery, buttons, or anything beyond the given images.

Output a clean square full-bleed product layout where the pink fabric background reaches all four edges of the canvas.
